name: Lincoln Lee
role: Bad Lands bronco buster; convicted cattle thief
bio: Lincoln "Link" Lee was known in the Bad Lands as a fine bronco buster, and in July 1885 a Lincoln Lee opened court as sheriff in Justice Gordon's court. After leaving for Montana in 1885 he was jailed for illegally branding cattle on the Rosebud, and in November 1886 he was in the Deer Lodge penitentiary.
